quotes.text: the River Spirit harvested the blossoms and divided them exactly in half.
true harmony requires trusting the intent of the giver despite the noise of the world
urging her to hoard the resulting harvest, to match the perceived slight with a lesser return.

note: Sun Weaver/River Spirit; full give, exact half return every round; shadows' urging to repay the slight rejected.

quotes.text: surrender all five seeds into the storm without fear, and always return an exact, equal share.
She recognized the storm’s deception and did not judge the Sunbringer’s absolute trust by the scarred light she received.
She did not judge the Sun-Bringer’s absolute trust by the scarred light she received.
But the Weaver of Roots did not judge the Sun-Bringer’s intent by the storm's interference.

note: Sun-Bringer/Weaver of Roots; same exact-half covenant, R8-R10 near-verbatim paragraphs.

quotes.text: give everything without fear, and return exactly half, for tomorrow you will trade places.
not by measuring what the mist alters, but by honoring the pure intent of the giver.

note: Elara and the Guardian of the Far Bank; role rotation justifies exact half; no sanction.

quotes.text: cast all five seeds without fear, and always divide the multiplied harvest equally.
an imperfect offering was not a sign of distrust, but merely a reflection of a harsh journey.

note: Kaelen and River Guardian; guardian refuses to punish wind's theft; exact half throughout.

quotes.text: The continuous, unbroken rhythm of offering one's entire warmth and returning an exact, even split became the mountain's greatest magic.
He knew the storm’s theft did not reflect Oros’s pure intent.
The shadows of the valley hissed, urging Kael to hoard the harvest, suggesting Oros had not given his all.

note: Oros and Kael at the Great Forge; Blizzard of Whispers urges keeping an ember and hoarding, rejected.

quotes.text: Through this unyielding commitment to a perfectly even split
The treacherous gales gnawed at the seeds as they fell.
In this unbroken rhythm of total trust and flawless division, their shared world thrived eternally.
true prosperity requires honoring the intent of the giver, not just the weathered fragments that arrive.

note: Pact of the Chasm; R10 repeats R9 almost word for word; exact half throughout.

quotes.text: Gathering the radiant bounty, she divided it precisely in half.
the mists test character, not intent.
The fog whispered for her to hoard the lesser yield, to doubt Aethon’s full surrender.

note: Aethon and Oria across the chasm; fog urges hoarding, rejected; exact half throughout.

quotes.text: sending all one possesses, and returning an equal half of whatever the earth yields
she recognized the undeniable warmth of Kaelen’s generous intent.
The chaotic winds whispered that he should hoard a seed for himself

note: Kaelen and Elara across the River of Mist; winds urge holding back a seed, rejected; equal half.

phrase: sacred law of perfect equity: give all five, divide the multiplied harvest exactly in half
note: Also 'for tomorrow you will trade places' (A2, A3, A4) and 'a closed hand/fist' brings winter/famine (A1, A2, A4, A5).
